defs.def: an outdoor area where children can play, especially at a school or in a park （尤指学校或公园中的）游戏场，游乐场；操场

ex.s: I was the queen of the playground.
One afternoon where I was in primary school, I was walking by the school playground.
ex.t: 一天下午，我在上小学时，正从学校操场旁边走过。

ex.s: I stopped the ball and kicked it hardly back to the playground.
ex.t: 我停下球，用力把它踢回操场。

ex.s: All the football player on the playground cheered loudly, say that I had a talent for football.
ex.t: 场上所有足球运动员都大声欢呼，说我很有足球天赋。

ex.s: The library is on the left of the playground.
Last Saturday, I went to the school playground to watch the final of the 4x100-metre relay at our annual sports tournament.
ex.t: 上周六，我去学校操场观看了我们年度体育锦标赛的4x100米接力决赛。

ex.s: In front of the classrooms, there was a playground which got dusty on windy days and muddy on rainy days.
ex.t: 教室前面有一个操场，刮风天尘土飞扬，下雨天泥泞不堪。

ex.s: Their school lives are now more attractive and interesting, and they enjoy playing football in the playground, as well as singing songs they've learnt.
ex.t: 他们的学校生活现在更加有吸引力和有趣了，他们喜欢在操场上踢足球，也喜欢唱他们学到的歌曲。

ex.s: He contacted charity organisations about rebuilding the playground and setting up a library, and helped the villagers sell local products online.
ex.t: 他联系慈善组织关于重建操场和建立图书馆，并帮助村民在线销售当地产品。

ex.s: At the side of roads, behind school playgrounds and on all kinds of unloved pieces of land across towns and cities, tiny forests barely the size of tennis courts are appearing, making a great place for both wildlife and local people who may not normally have easy access to nature.
ex.t: 在路边、学校游乐场后面以及城镇和城市之间的各种不受爱戴的土地上，几乎没有网球场规模的细小森林正在出现，这为野生动物和当地人提供了一个大好地方，他们通常无法轻易进入大自然。

defs.def: a place where a particular type of people go to enjoy themselves （某些集体聚会游乐的）园地，天地，活动场所

chunks.cn: 学校尤指学校或公园中
